log.m: Bar confirmed reachable — headed Chrome defeats the Cloudflare interstitial.
Captured voxiom.io live: menu, in-game HUD, 60.2 fps median, 3.16 s to interactive.
Wrote ref/BAR.md — seven measured weaknesses in the bar become the product strategy.
Spine workflow launched: contract -> renderer / world / server in parallel -> integration gate.
Mobile bar captured. voxiom REFUSES to play in portrait — 'Please rotate your screen'. Landscape has no fire button; aim and shoot are the same gesture.
Re-measured the bar under 4x CPU throttle (throttle verified linear): 60.2 median but 1% low falls to 53.8. Beating the bar = >53.8; our spec of 55 is deliberately harder.
Spine RUNS. 25,330 lines, 18/18 + 19/19 + 29/29 tests green. Real voxel world, HUD, 7 Doom weapons, 6 players, 33 entities, zero console errors.
Perf measured honestly: headed + throttled we are 60.2/53.8 — IDENTICAL to the bar. The 120 fps was a headless capture artifact. A tie is a loss.
Scope expanded by user: quest mode, builder mode, multiplayer, more modes. Captured DOOM 1993 (E1M1, real gameplay) and verified Minecraft Classic as two new bars.
Spine final: dynamic crosshair spread, 7-pellet shotgun sparks, killfeed, in-engine menu, full settings panel, 3 reserved ad slots. 312 ms to interactive, zero console errors.
Mobile PORTRAIT confirmed playable by eye — big FIRE pad, labelled JUMP/CRCH/RUN/RLD/BLD, real joystick. The bar refuses portrait entirely. Decisive win.
Mode framework landed (level format = data, 3 Quest levels). Four mode builders still in flight at pause.
Queued by user: advertiser-buyable in-game ads, GTA mode, ElevenLabs voices. GTA bar NOT yet obtainable — flagged, not faked. Paused for handover; resume 22:00.

Economy layer specced (docs/ECONOMY.md): 2 currencies, tradable cosmetics, escrow trading, viral sharing, competitions. Three architecture calls: server grants all rewards; no loot boxes / no real-money tradables by default; sponsor PLATFORM is buildable, a sponsor deal is not mine to make.
Sponsor spec done. Key finding: the 1.5% screen-coverage floor (not fog) is the binding constraint on in-world ads — a 4x2 m billboard only qualifies within 7.7 m, so author at 16x8 m minimum.

Rejected client-side WebGL2 occlusion queries: 0.19 ms spike lands on the 18.6 ms p99 tail = 53.2 fps 1% low, under our 53.8 line. Chose server-side reconstruction from existing yaw/pitch inputs — 0.000 ms client cost.
TWO REAL BUGS found, unrelated to ads: net pump runs inside rAF so backgrounding the tab 15 s DISCONNECTS you mid-match; and there is no CSP anywhere on the server. See docs/BUGS-FOUND.md.

User decisions: run BOTH programmatic (AdSense/networks) as fill AND direct-sold as it arrives; support ALL THREE prize shapes. Flagged: AdSense covers page slots only — in-game/rewarded needs a games network (the bar uses AdInPlay).
Textures landed and measured: dark surfaces 0.66->2.72 and 0.84->3.39 grey levels, inside the bar band. At matched luminance our sand 3.62 vs bar 3.32, grass 4.35 vs 4.39 — dead level.
Found the metric is scale-dependent: voxiom own sand reads 1.80 at nose, 3.32 mid, 8.51 far. The "3.32 band" was one slice of a curve. Our depth curve now sits on theirs.
Both real bugs fixed: net pump off rAF (tab-background no longer disconnects), CSP added. Regression to fix: quest tile floor went 4.03 -> 2.56 because seam strength was cut.
Handover plan written: Phase A economy, B sponsors/ads, C platform, D defects. GitHub push blocked until tools/.profile-mc (Cookies + Login Data) is purged from 2 commits of history.
A1 reward spine: EntitlementGuard + trust.ts (1,766 lines) were imported by nothing. Now on every live match. 1503 → 1562 tests.

Audit found a proven __proto__ self-grant past guardProfileWrite (1e9 XP), Math.random() account secrets, an unauthenticated account-link, a join-code leak. All closed; exploits re-run against the real binary.
Two decision docs: docs/PACKS.md (content packs; CONTENT_VERSION gates nothing today) and docs/PLATFORM.md (accounts, console, profile).
Server tier LIVE on Railway: doomcraft-production.up.railway.app — document + rooms from one origin; /api/version folds level hashes; /api/levels mounted; admin console at /admin behind the bearer.
